$comment: Theme choices for scripts/tokens.ts; every other token comes from Jetpack Compose (tokens/androidx). Colour roles come from material-color-utilities with the 2025 (Expressive) spec. The typefaces are bundled (src/fonts): Google Sans Flex, then Roboto Flex for the Cyrillic and Greek it lacks. motion picks the expressive or standard spring scheme.

typeface.brand: 'Google Sans Flex', 'Roboto Flex', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
typeface.plain: 'Google Sans Flex', 'Roboto Flex', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
